power.description: Power consumption per building (MW). Negative = produces.

speed.description: Speed multiplier for the recipes, default 1 (the items/min values are multiplied by it).

icon.description: Image inside the public/icons/ folder, e.g. buildings/smelter.svg

maxInputs.description: How many recipe inputs it supports (for validation). Default 4.

upgradeOf.description: Upgraded variant: the id of the base building (marked ↑). It inherits recipes only with inheritRecipes: true.

inheritRecipes.description: true: also runs the recipes of the upgradeOf building with the speed multiplier. The StarRupture v.2 buildings have their own recipe lists, so the default is false.

cost.description: Build cost of one building: { item_id: pieces }. The summary computes the minimum build cost from it.

type.description: Building type. Default: production (runs recipes). miner: a mine (mines: table).

mines.description: For a mine: what it mines, items/min. item_id: 240, or per purity: item_id: { impure: 60, normal: 120, pure: 240 } (the purity ids of game.yml).

oneOf.description: A single purity: items/min (no purity picker).

capacity.description: For a storage: how many pieces fit into one storage.

throughput.description: For a Dispatcher: throughput in items/min. One number, or per feed rail tier: { v.1: 100, v.2: 171.4, v.3: 266.7 } (the rail names of game.yml).

railOutputs.description: For a Receiver: number of rail outputs (the limit of the outgoing flow).
